verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs include an 'Selecting an Audit Partner' page under the Audits section, which suggests founders can pick an auditor through the vendor, and the platform supports working with the auditor in-platform. The pack gives only the page title, though, with no content describing the auditor network, how vetting works, how booking happens, or what timeline to expect. missing for 10: description of a vetted auditor network or in-house audit arm, the booking/engagement workflow, published audit timeline expectations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can book the audit itself through the vendor — a vetted auditor network or in-house audit arm with published expectations on timeline

citations.quote: work cross-functionally with your team and auditor in-platform
